secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://<ref>.supabase.co). Optional — code has a hardcoded fallback for development.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Supabase project ref ID. Optional — not strictly required to boot.
